# Humble Bundle Ebook Downloader (v4.0.0)

## Description
A fast, concurrent CLI tool built with **Deno** to download, verify, and sync ebooks, comics, audiobooks/soundtracks, videos, games, and Humble Vault (Trove) items from Humble Bundle's Next.js + Ory Kratos platform.

## Tech Stack
- **Runtime**: Deno (v1.40+ / v2.x)
- **Language**: TypeScript
- **Dependencies**:
  - `@henrygd/queue` (bounded concurrency queues)
  - `@std/*` (standard library: assert, async, cli, collections, crypto, encoding, fmt, fs, path)

## Project Structure

### Entry Point & Config
- **`index.ts`**: Main CLI entry point. Parses arguments, manages signal shutdown, initializes concurrency queues (`fileCheck`, `orderInfo`, `downloads`), and dispatches commands.
- **`deno.json`**: Deno configuration (`version: "4.0.0"`, import map, `deno task test` and `deno task check`).

### Core Modules (`utils/`)
- `constants.ts`: Version, `COMMANDS`, `DEFAULT_FORMATS` (`cb?`, `epub`, `pdf_hd`, `pdf`, `mobi`), `DEFAULT_AUDIO_FORMATS`, `SUPPORTED_VIDEO_QUALITIES`, CLI flag aliases, and defaults.
- `web.ts`: Humble Bundle Next.js App Router integration — Netscape `cookie.txt` / Ory Kratos session cookie handling, `RSC: 1` React Flight stream parser (`parseRscStream`, `resolveFlightRefs`), dynamic Next.js Server Action discovery (`filterUserLibrary`, `getSignedUrlsForEntitlements`, `getVaultSignedUrls`), URL signing micro-batching, and `bundles.legacy.json` / `troves.archive.json` preservation.
- `orders.ts`: Filtering, deduplication, and format/quality prioritization across `filterEbooks`, `filterAudio`, `filterVideos`, and `filterBundles` (`selectVideoStructs`, `selectAudioStructs`).
- `download.ts`: Resumable `.part` HTTP Range downloads, signed URL refresh on 401/403, hardlink/relocation deduplication, `.opf`/`.nfo` & cover sidecars, archive extraction, and `verifyItems` / `repair`.
- `troves.ts`: Humble Vault (Trove) platform filtering and `DownloadInfo` construction.
- `fileUtils.ts`: Atomic JSON read/write (compact for large caches), dirty-tracked `checksums.json` cache, safe `clean()` (with `.trash` backup support via `--backup-replaced`, protecting `.opf`/`.nfo`/cover sidecars), `--diff` library diffing, `.m3u8` playlists, `catalog.json`/`catalog.csv` export, `stats`, `bundles`, and `unclaimed` reports.
- `checksums.ts`: Streaming SHA-1/MD5 hashing, signature verification, file relocation/hardlinking, and `--deep` binary header/trailer validation (`.pdf`, `.epub`, `.cbz`, `.cbr`, `.zip`, `.gz`, `.bz2`, `.xz`, `.mobi`, `.prc`).
- `generic.ts`: `parseCookieInput`, `normalizeBundleKey`, `expandFormatPreferences` (`cb?` -> `cbz`, `cbr`, `cb7`, `cbt`, `cba`), `detectAudioFormat`, `detectVideoQuality`, filename sanitization, and filter/date/size matchers.
- `options.ts`: CLI argument validation, `.humblerc.json` + `HUMBLE_*` env var merging, `options.json` persistence, and `bash`/`zsh`/`fish` shell completions.
- `progressWrapper.ts` & `streamProgress.ts`: ANSI-aware multi-bar terminal progress renderer, file logger, and global token-bucket bandwidth limiter.
- `formatNumbers.ts`: Byte size, percentage, and duration formatters.

### Types & Tests
- **`types/`**: `general.ts`, `bundle.ts`, `trove.ts`.
- **`tests/utils/`**: Unit test suite covering all utility modules (`deno task test`).

## Commands
- `ebooks`: Download ebooks & comics with format priority (`-f`, default `cb?` -> `epub` -> `pdf_hd` -> `pdf` -> `mobi`).
- `audio`: Download soundtracks, audiobooks, and comedy albums with codec priority (`-a`, default `flac` -> `alac` -> `wav` -> `aiff` -> `m4b` -> `m4a` -> `aac` -> `ogg` -> `opus` -> `mp3`).
- `videos` (alias `video`): Download videos, courses, and comedy specials with resolution priority (`-q`, default `best`).
- `all`: Download all items matching selected `-p` platforms.
- `trove`: Download Humble Vault (Trove) items.
- `verify` / `repair`: Verify local files from disk (with optional `--deep` binary checks) and repair corrupted/missing files.
- `stats` (`list`), `bundles`, `unclaimed`, `export`: Library inspection and catalog export commands.
- `checksums`: Precompute and cache SHA-1/MD5 hashes of existing local files (supports `--prune`).
- `cleanup`, `cleanupaudio`, `cleanupebooks`, `cleanuptrove`, `cleanupvideos`: Remove local files not in the resolved download set.
- `cleanuptrash`: Purge `.trash/` backup files older than `--trash-max-age` days.
- `completions [bash|zsh|fish]`: Output shell tab-completion script.
- Key flags: `--update` (incremental), `--force-update` (full refresh), `--yes` / `-y`, `--show-config`, `--strict-checksums`, `--extract-clean`, `--external-links`.
